meta.name: lark-workflow-standup-report
meta.description: 日程待办摘要：编排 calendar +agenda 和 task +get-my-tasks，生成指定日期的日程与未完成任务摘要。适用于了解今天/明天/本周的安排。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动汇总日程与待办，生成每日工作摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每天需要快速了解当日日程和未完成任务
copy.tagline_en: Automatically summarize calendar and tasks for daily standup
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick daily summary of your schedule and pending tasks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先读取 lark-shared 文档以处理认证与权限，再调用 lark-cli 获取指定日期的会议与未完成任务，最后输出一份摘要：含日程表、待办列表、会议/待办总数、冲突提醒和空闲时段。
howto.when: 当用户询问某天或某段日期的日程与待办摘要时触发（例如“今天有什么安排”“standup report”）。该技能仅支持 user 身份。

say.note: Claude 会生成今天的日程和待办摘要。

say.text: 帮我生成明天的日程和未完成任务摘要
say.note: Claude 会列出明天日程与到期待办。
Claude 会生成本周日程及未完成待办摘要。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude first reads the lark-shared doc to handle auth and permissions, then uses lark-cli to fetch events and unfinished tasks for a given date, and outputs a summary with a schedule table, todo list, counts, conflict alerts, and free slots.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a user asks about their schedule or todos for a day or period, e.g. "What's on today?" or mentions "standup report". This skill supports the user identity only.

say_en.note: Claude will produce today's schedule and todo summary.

say_en.text: Generate tomorrow's schedule and unfinished task summary.
say_en.note: Claude lists tomorrow's events and due todos.

say_en.text: What else is scheduled this week?
say_en.note: Claude generates a weekly schedule and open-todo summary.
